import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Force reset to main
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git checkout main --force && git reset --hard origin/main 2>&1 | tail -5")
print("Reset:", stdout.read().decode())

# Restart
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart areloria 2>&1 | tail -3")

import time
time.sleep(5)

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep 3000")
print("\nPort 3000:", stdout.read().decode())

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 logs areloria --lines 10 --nostream 2>&1 | tail -10")
print("\nLogs:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
